meta.description: South Korea NPK recommendations for 9 crops — user-supplied data (2026-10-13) with RDA (Rural Development Administration) / NICS sources. All values per hectare, no conversion.

records.applicationMethod: 50% N + full P + 70% K as basal. 20% N top-dressed at tillering (14 days after transplanting). 30% N + 30% K top-dressed at panicle initiation (45 days after transplanting).
records.applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting; tillering (14 DAT); panicle initiation (45 DAT).
records.notes: N 90-110 kg/ha; P2O5 45-55 kg/ha; K2O 50-65 kg/ha. Lowland standard paddy.
records.source_org_2: RDA National Institute of Crop Science (NICS)

records.applicationMethod: 40% N + full P and K applied as basal in autumn. Remaining 60% N top-dressed in late winter (mid-February).
records.applicationTiming: Basal in autumn; top-dress in late winter (mid-February).
records.notes: N 80-100 kg/ha; P2O5 50-70 kg/ha; K2O 40-60 kg/ha. Winter feed / naked barley.
records.source_org: RDA National Institute of Crop Science (NICS)

records.applicationMethod: 50% N + full P and K applied as basal. Remaining 50% N top-dressed at spring green-up (late February to early March).
records.applicationTiming: Basal at sowing; top-dress at spring green-up (late Feb to early March).
records.notes: N 90-120 kg/ha; P2O5 60-80 kg/ha; K2O 40-60 kg/ha. Winter wheat (Uri-Mil).

records.applicationMethod: Entire fertilizer banded at seeding (starter nitrogen only; crop fixes the rest biologically).
records.notes: N 25-35 kg/ha (starter); P2O5 60-80 kg/ha; K2O 60-80 kg/ha.
records.source_org: RDA National Institute of Crop Science (NICS)

records.applicationMethod: 50% N + all P and K applied as basal. Remaining 50% N side-dressed at knee-high stage (V6).
records.applicationTiming: Basal at planting; side-dress at knee-high (V6).
records.notes: N 150-180 kg/ha; P2O5 80-100 kg/ha; K2O 100-130 kg/ha. Silage and grain maize.

records.applicationMethod: 100% of fertilizer applied as basal beneath bed film mulching.
records.micronutrients: SOP (sulphate of potash) preferred for quality.
records.notes: N 100-130 kg/ha; P2O5 80-110 kg/ha; K2O 100-140 kg/ha. Spring cropping.
records.source_org: RDA Highland Agriculture Research Institute, Daegwallyeong

records.applicationMethod: Entire dose applied as basal along the ridge prior to mulching.
records.applicationTiming: Basal along ridge prior to mulching.
records.notes: N 40-60 kg/ha; P2O5 50-70 kg/ha; K2O 90-130 kg/ha.
records.source_org: RDA Bioenergy Crop Research Institute, Muan

records.applicationMethod: 100% of fertilizer incorporated into ridges under vinyl mulch.
records.applicationTiming: Incorporated into ridges under vinyl mulch.
records.notes: N 40-60 kg/ha; P2O5 35-50 kg/ha; K2O 40-55 kg/ha. Chamkkae.
records.source_org: RDA National Institute of Crop Science (NICS)

records.applicationMethod: Full basal placement of NPK before bed vinyl mulching. Lime applied separately to adjust soil pH.
records.applicationTiming: Full basal placement before bed vinyl mulching.
records.micronutrients: Lime 1,000 kg/ha applied to adjust soil pH.
records.notes: N 20-30 kg/ha; P2O5 50-70 kg/ha; K2O 60-80 kg/ha.
